text:
sam.partnerships: Heads up 8- week countdown for Nimbus Systems Edge bundle in the CloudStore. Go/no-go review planned for Fri. We need marketplace listing, co-announcement, localized landing pages (EN/JP/DE), and cert language for the HW bundle.

toni-product-marketing: Timeline check  we can freeze assets Wed COB and content localization by Thu. Agency can handle JP/DE if we get copy by Wed.

alex-press: Requesting embargo window: 5/12 08:00 PT. Need CEO quote and partner quote from Nimbus comms by Tue EOD. Also want a short FAQ for press.

rui-se: Integration status: Nimbus SDK passed handshake tests. Remaining: sample CI config for SI flows and support matrix doc. I can produce ci.yml snippet.

priya-engineering: HW bundle packaging note: boot order tweak required for NIM-HW-EDGE image to attach GPU. I'll push a patch tonight. QA will re-run smoke tests tomorrow morning.

marta-legal: Reviewed co-announcement draft. Please remove clause about "unlimited support". Also we need to add an EU data residency checkbox for customers selecting EU region.

kevin-creative: I'll build three hero variations: default, enterprise, and localized hero for JP. Where should assets live?

sam.partnerships: Put them in /shared/partners/nimbus/marketplace-assets and tag me. Also confirm SKU naming and meter slug.

toni-product-marketing: Proposed SKUs: NIM-EDGE-1, NIM-EDGE-1-HW-BUNDLE. Meter slug: nimbus.edge.unit. Pricing TBD but we need placeholders for listing.

nimbus-marketing: Confirming partner quote: "Bringing Redwood inference to Nimbus edge devices unlocks low-latency AI for our customers." Will send signed version.

alex-press: Quick note on PR copy: avoid technical density; highlight "low-latency inference at the edge" and joint support. Also we need embargo-safe screenshots.

rui-se: Sample CI snippet for microsite deploy (use in docs):

```
steps:
  - name: build-image
    run: ./scripts/build-nim-image.sh --sku NIM-EDGE-1
  - name: deploy-to-staging
    run: rcli deploy --provider=nimbus --sku NIM-EDGE-1-HW-BUNDLE --region eu-west-1
```

priya-engineering: FYI the boot tweak PR: https://git.example/r/repo/pull/789 will merge by 22:00 PT. QA scheduled 09:00 PT tomorrow.

marta-legal: Also need to approve the localized privacy snippet for DE and JP. I'll review translations but need final copy from localization team.

launch-bot: Playbook reminder created: "Nimbus Marketplace Go/No-Go Review" Fri 5/10 09:00 PT. Runbook: https://runbooks.example/nimbus-go-no-go

kevin-creative: Uploaded hero sets and screenshot comps to /shared/partners/nimbus/marketplace-assets at 11:36 PT. JP hero has alternate headline; see notes.

toni-product-marketing: Action list recap: Alex  finalize PR and CEO quote (Tue EOD). Nimbus marketing  return partner-approved quote (Tue EOD). Kevin  finalize assets (Wed AM). Priya  confirm boot-fix merged + QA pass (Wed AM). Rui  CI snippet + support matrix (Wed EOD). Marta  localized legal blurbs (Thu EOD). Sam  coordinate rehearsal and marketplace pricing placeholders.

nimbus-marketing: We'll confirm partner legal signoff by Thu.

alex-press: Will draft a short FAQ for embargo and attach screenshots that are blur-guarded.

sam.partnerships: If any blockers crop up, drop here and @launch-bot will ping the list. :shipit:
